name: herder
description: Shape focused plans and execute them with bounded review, independent judging, recovery, usage accounting, and optional Orca cross-harness routing.

interface.shortDescription: Clarify, create, and execute plans with specialized agents.
interface.longDescription: Herder shapes requested changes and verified findings into focused dependency-aware plans, compiles shared context into immutable snapshots, validates file budgets and write scopes, executes bounded implementation-review rounds, independently judges convergence, rescues authorized failures, integrates verified work transactionally, records per-attempt token usage with honest coverage, and can route roles across CLI harnesses through Orca.
defaultPrompt: Grill me one decision at a time, then create a focused validated Herder plan graph for this objective.
Interactively configure and verify Herder role routing for this repository.
Audit this repository and create prioritized Herder plans.
Fire the implementation plans in this repository.
